{{Quote|Make way for the Majestrix of Skye!|A [[Catuman]] warrior escorting Kharys among the crowd of the [[Great Fair]]|<ref name="Annual">[[Star Wars Annual (1977) 1|''Star Wars Annual'' (1977) 1]]</ref>}}
'''Magister of Skye''',<ref name="Skyewalkers" /> also known as the '''Majestrix of Skye'''<ref name="Annual" /> was a title that the genetics terrorist [[Zeta Magnus]] bestowed upon himself after taking control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]<ref name="Skyewalkers" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> However, Magnus was foiled by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Halagad Ventor]] shortly thereafter.<ref name="Skyewalkers" /> [[Kharys]] used the title "Majestrix of Skye" during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="Annual" />
